steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Brown **2 lb ground beef** and **2 onions**, chopped.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Add **1½ tsp mustard**, **1½ cans tomato soup**, **4½ Tbsp catsup**, **2¼ Tbsp brown sugar** and **1½ Tbsp vinegar**, and simmer until desired consistency, adding water as needed.
